question: In which of the following states is the Behdienkhlam Festival celebrated, in which the young men make a symbolic gesture of driving away of the evil spirit, plague and disease by beating the roof of every house with bamboo poles?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Behdienkhlam Festival is celebrated in the state of **Meghalaya**, primarily by the Pnar tribal community of the Jaintia Hills region.
 
• The festival typically takes place in the month of **July**, marking the end of the sowing season and praying for a bountiful harvest.
 
• Young men perform symbolic rituals to drive away **evil spirits, plagues, and diseases** by beating the roofs of houses with bamboo poles.
 
• A key highlight of the festival is the traditional dance performed around a sacred pool, where logs called "Rots" are immersed as part of the ceremonies.
 
• The festival is deeply rooted in the cultural and religious beliefs of the Pnar people and showcases their reverence for nature and ancestral traditions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Meaning of Behdienkhlam:** The name "Behdienkhlam" translates to "driving away the plague" in the Pnar language. It reflects the community's effort to ward off diseases and evil forces.
 
• **Ritual of Rots:** Wooden logs called "Rots" are decorated and carried through the village before being immersed in a sacred pool. This symbolizes unity and the collective effort to overcome challenges.
 
• **Ka Nohsni:** A special women-only dance called "Ka Nohsni" is performed during the festival, emphasizing the importance of women in Pnar society.
 
• **Religious Significance:** The festival is closely associated with the worship of the thunder god, known as "U Blei Shyllong," and other deities, seeking their blessings for prosperity and protection.
 
• **Tourism and Cultural Promotion:** The Behdienkhlam Festival has gained recognition as a major cultural event, attracting tourists and promoting Meghalaya's rich tribal heritage on a global stage.
